description: This file contains utility functions and processes related to Italian e-invoicing within the ERPNext system, including invoice preparation, validation, attachment handling, and tax calculations.

methods.name: update_itemised_tax_data
methods.description: Updates tax data for invoice items based on itemised tax calculations.

methods.name: export_invoices
methods.description: Exports sales invoices as e-invoice ZIP files based on provided filters.

methods.name: prepare_invoice
methods.description: Prepares invoice data with company, customer, and tax details for e-invoicing.

methods.name: get_conditions
methods.description: Builds query conditions for fetching invoices based on filters.

methods.name: download_zip
methods.description: Creates and serves a ZIP file containing invoice attachments.

methods.name: get_invoice_summary
methods.description: Generates a summary of invoice taxes and charges for e-invoice generation.

methods.name: sales_invoice_validate
methods.description: Validates sales invoice data before e-invoice processing.

methods.name: sales_invoice_on_submit
methods.description: Validates payment schedule and prepares invoice attachment upon submission.

methods.name: prepare_and_attach_invoice
methods.description: Generates XML e-invoice file and attaches it to the sales invoice document.

methods.name: generate_single_invoice
methods.description: Generates and attaches a single e-invoice for a given sales invoice.

methods.name: sales_invoice_on_cancel
methods.description: Removes e-invoice attachments when a sales invoice is canceled.

methods.name: get_company_country
methods.description: Retrieves the country of the company for validation purposes.

methods.name: get_e_invoice_attachments
methods.description: Fetches existing e-invoice XML attachments for invoices.

methods.name: validate_address
methods.description: Validates address fields required for e-invoicing.

methods.name: get_unamended_name
methods.description: Returns the original name of an invoice, considering amendments.

methods.name: get_progressive_name_and_number
methods.description: Generates a unique progressive name and number for e-invoice files.

methods.name: set_state_code
methods.description: Sets the state code based on the state name for Italian addresses.
